contract: platform-design-contract.md: Indonesian QIE prediction platform with real escrow semantics and explicitly labelled idea-only discovery before deployment.

accessibility.evidence: Labelled buttons and search; keyboard shortcut, dialog focus trapping, Escape and focus restoration tested. Focus rings and reduced motion CSS present. High contrast burgundy/neutral and green/red labels visually reviewed.

responsive.evidence: Measured document scrollWidth against innerWidth on desktop/tablet/mobile for discovery, portfolio and creation; all passed.

loading.evidence: Delayed mock RPC leaves labelled idea discovery usable.

empty.evidence: Unmatched search and empty watchlist show useful empty states with recovery links.

error.evidence: Invalid pasted platform manifest yields a visible error without an RPC write.

partial.evidence: Failed public deployment manifest shows a configuration notice while nine labelled ideas remain usable.

success.evidence: Bookmark saves, persists on reload, and removes correctly; idea becomes a draft. Separate receipt browser regression checks create/stake/deploy recovery.

permission.evidence: Disconnected portfolio and create form explain wallet/setup prerequisites and never invent funded positions.

renderedEvidence.observation: Desktop shows market discovery, labelled ideas, categories, search, and no fabricated odds or funded markets.
tablet discovery has no document overflow; category strip scrolls inside its container and cards reflow without clipping.
mobile discovery has no document overflow; category strip scrolls inside its container and cards reflow without clipping.

checks: category, search, combined filters, empty results and reset operate on idea data
bookmarks persist across reload and removal updates the saved page
using an idea prepares a draft, requires actual rules and source, and keeps publishing gated
disconnected portfolio shows no invented balance; connection dialog traps focus, Escape closes, and focus restores
learning page and native accessible FAQ disclosure work
search keyboard shortcut focuses the labelled search control
skip-to-content preserves the current hash route and focuses main content
discovery, portfolio and creation are usable at desktop, tablet and mobile widths
reduced motion media preference is respected
manifest failure preserves discovery and malformed platform configuration is rejected visibly
discovery is immediately usable while network checks are still loading
